purpose: Br I same-orbit relational control and current NIST ASD transition screening.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or a negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, navigation pages, and repeated copies of the same substantive source are provenance aliases, not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Substantive off-topic publications surfaced by search may be routed as reusable methodology/domain intelligence or negative-control material; search appearance never grants Glob evidence weight.

sources.title: NIST Atomic Spectra Database Lines Data — Br I
sources.observed_access_state: 170 Br I lines in the current ASD selection; NIST states this set contains the strongest lines from the Reader et al. compilation plus selected additional lines.
sources.note: Use as current Br I transition-screening dataset. Absence from this selected ASD set is a bounded negative result, not proof that no weak historical line exists.

sources.title: NIST ASD Spectral Lines Help — Wavenumbers
sources.note: Defines stored versus calculated observed wavenumbers and Ritz wavenumbers from evaluated levels; use as the canonical conversion/reconciliation rule for transition matching.

relational_tests.threshold_scope: Deliberately strict screening threshold for this test; it is not asserted as a universal spectroscopy tolerance.

level_results.context: Compact NIST Br I level table jumps from the ground-term 3685.24 cm^-1 level to 63436.45 cm^-1; no level lies within +/-1 cm^-1 of 57796.

transition_results.note: The established 75697.05 result is an energy level, not being reclassified as a transition merely from wavelength conversion.

relational_tests.conclusion: No second tight same-orbit Br I level or selected-ASD transition counterpart was found. The 75697.05 level remains a single P1 near-match rather than a Br I P2 same-orbit closure.
relational_tests.claims_boundary: This negative result is bounded to the authoritative compact level table and current ASD selected-line set searched; NIST notes weaker lines exist in primary references beyond the selected current line set.
Outside the +/-1 cm^-1 screening threshold; retained specifically to prevent tolerance creep.

next_actions: Repeat same-orbit level and transition screening for current Yb II using authoritative NIST data.

Apply multiple-testing correction across all orbit/species/dataset screens.
